CVE-2026-19880.title: Path-traversal vulnerability in QOS.CH Sarl Logback-classic on Ja ...
CVE-2026-19880.description:
Path-traversal vulnerability in QOS.CH Sarl Logback-classic on Java (logback-classic module) allows path-traversal vulnerability. More specifically, an 
MDC-based discriminator value flows unsanitized into a nested 
FileAppender path, letting an attacker who influences that MDC value 
(e.g. via an HTTP header)
 create and append log files outside the intended directory. 


This issue affects Logback-classic: from 0.9.14 through 1.6.2.

CVE-2026-59272.title: Any application shipping logs to RabbitMQ over TLS via the Log4j2 ...
CVE-2026-59272.description:
Any application shipping logs to RabbitMQ over TLS via the Log4j2 appender, relying on the documented default, is exposed to man-in-the-middle interception of every log event.
Spring AMQP 4.1.0
Spring AMQP 4.0.0 - 4.0.4
Spring AMQP 3.2.0 - 3.2.12
Spring AMQP 2.4.18 and earlier
